verdict.rationale: Coinbase documents first-party ways to operate the product in natural language through an AI assistant. The CDP CLI ships an MCP server (`cdp mcp`) that exposes every API endpoint as a tool. Coinbase Wallet MCP and the Agentic Wallet skills (fund, send, trade, monetize) are triggered by natural-language intents, and the docs include example prompts and an approval gate on write actions. Missing for 10: a built-in natural-language interface that doesn't depend on an external AI client, explicit natural-language examples for the custodial payments flows (checkout, payouts, fiat rails), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
